As displayed in Figure \ref{overview}c, in most cases, the down-sampling layer involves a strided convolution operation where the stride is set to 2 in all dimensions. However, in practice, the stride with respect to specific dimension can be set to 1 as the number of slices is limited in this dimension and over-down-sampling (i.e., using a large down-sampling stride) can be harmful.
